info.name: SourceFX
info.comment: Renders a source vector in the effect pipeline.

description.p: SourceFX renders a vector branch into the filter primitive subregion. The branch is selected with Source, or with SourceName for a definition registered in the scene. The vector must belong to the same VectorScene as the filter. Either field can be set at any time, including after initialisation, to replace the branch.

Technically the SourceFX object is represented by a new viewport, the bounds of which are defined by the primitive subregion set by the X, Y, Width and Height fields. By default the branch is drawn at its original size with its origin at the top-left corner of the subregion, and it is clipped to the subregion. The viewport has no view box in this case, so the AspectRatio field does not scale the vector. This is how web browsers place an element referenced by the SVG feImage primitive.

Set ViewBox to render a section of the branch, such as one cell of a vector atlas. The section, given in the user coordinates of the source vector, becomes the view box of the viewport and is fitted to the subregion according to AspectRatio. Artwork outside the section is clipped.
Changes to the source branch, including its destruction, are detected automatically and cause buffered viewports that use the filter to be redrawn.

If the subregion is not set, it defaults to the filter region. The vector then moves with the filtered element: with a filter region that starts at (40, 40), a vector point at (0, 0) is drawn at (40, 40). Maps drawn by other routes, such as a pattern fill, will not line up with it. To draw the vector in the user space of the filtered element, set X and Y to 0 and set Width and Height so that the subregion covers the filter region. This applies when the filter's primitive units are user space, which is the default. In SVG:

action.name: Draw
action.comment: Render the source vector to the target bitmap.
action.prototype: ERR acDraw(*Object, DOUBLE X, DOUBLE Y, DOUBLE Width, DOUBLE Height)

input.param: The X position of the region to be drawn.
The Y position of the region to be drawn.
The width of the region to be drawn.
The height of the region to be drawn.

action.name: Refresh
action.comment: Redraws filter clients after an undetected change to the source.

description.p: Changes made through the fields and actions of the Source vector are detected automatically. Call Refresh after a change that the vector cannot detect, such as new content in a bitmap that one of its fills refers to, so that buffered viewports that use the filter discard their cached content.

AspectRatio applies only when ViewBox is set, and controls how the selected section is fitted to the primitive subregion. Without a ViewBox the source vector is drawn at its original size. The default is X_MID|Y_MID|MEET.

field.name: Source
field.comment: The source Vector that will be rendered.

description.p: Set Source to select the Vector branch that is rendered by the effect. The field can be set before or after initialisation. The vector must belong to the same VectorScene as the filter, or ERR::Mismatch is returned, and a vector that is being destroyed is rejected with ERR::MarkedForDeletion. The previous source remains active if the new value is rejected.

The effect holds a weak reference to the vector, so it does not keep the vector alive. Setting the field to null, or destroying the vector, makes the effect produce transparent output. Changes to the vector or its children cause buffered viewports that use the filter to be redrawn.

field.name: SourceName
field.comment: Name of a source definition to be rendered.

description.p: Setting SourceName looks up a definition registered with the filter's VectorScene and assigns it to Source. The field can be set before or after initialisation, but the effect must already belong to a VectorFilter. An unknown name returns ERR::Search, and the definition must be derived from the Vector class. If the lookup or validation fails, the previous source remains active. Set an empty string to clear the source.
Vectors are registered via the VectorScene.AddDef() method.

field.name: ViewBox
field.comment: Selects a section of the source vector, in its user coordinates.

description.p: By default the source vector is drawn at its original size. Set ViewBox to four values, { x, y, width, height }, to render only a section of it, such as one cell of a vector atlas. The section, given in the user coordinates of the Source vector, is fitted to the primitive subregion according to AspectRatio, in the same way as the viewBox of an SVG viewport. Artwork outside the section is clipped, including in the margins that a MEET aspect ratio leaves.

The width and height must be greater than zero and all values must be finite, or ERR::OutOfRange is returned and the current rectangle is retained. An array that does not have four values is rejected with ERR::InvalidValue.
Set an empty array, or a zero width and height, to clear the rectangle. Reading the field returns an empty array when no rectangle is set.
In SVG, the equivalent attribute is kotuku:viewBox="x y width height" on the feImage element.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Describes the primitive using the FilterEffect.XMLDef format.

constants.comment: Aspect ratios control alignment, scaling and clipping.
constants.const: Aspect ratio is preserved. The entire viewbox will be visible in the viewport. The viewbox is scaled up as much as possible.
Scale the viewbox to match the size of the viewport. Aspect ratio is not preserved.
Aspect ratio is preserved. The viewbox can extend beyond the viewport's edges on one axis. The viewbox is scaled up as much as possible.
